A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same IG-MC framework and MSTP benchmarks. Text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices A–J support comparison; v3 additionally includes a NeurIPS checklist.

before.justification: v1 reports original prediction experiments, module ablations, generated-frame analyses, and computational measurements in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, failure cases, and latency measurements.

M1.justification: The alternating DM/VG procedure, transition controller, hierarchical prediction agents, diffusion conditioning, and objectives are unchanged. Calling DM stateless in v3 restates its existing current-state/image inputs.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Action Genome-based MSTP-General relationship prediction and GraSP-based MSTP-Surgery phase/step prediction with the same coverage. Newly discussed datasets and models in related work are not additional evaluations.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 4–7 retain the same backbones and module comparisons, including Qwen2.5-VL, LLaVA1.5, Gemma3, InternVL3, and SurgVLM. The additional related-work citations do not introduce evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: The reported data construction, splits, temporal and incremental scales, evaluation metrics, and training/inference settings are unchanged. Figure 3's revised selection of displayed metrics does not establish a protocol change.

E4.justification: The DM/VG ablations, horizon-degradation analysis, VG-only experiment, failure cases, and multi-agent cumulative-error analysis are retained. Figure 3 simplifies the presentation of the existing analysis without adding or removing an experimental test.

E5.justification: Figure 3 adds shaded bands absent from v1, and checklist item 7 asserts uncertainty reporting. Their statistical meaning and calculation are not defined, and no run or seed counts are supplied; additional runs cannot be inferred.

E6.justification: Section 4.2 corrects five-second accuracy from 41.62% to 42.06%, matching the unchanged Figure 3 value rather than demonstrating a performance gain. Figure 3 also omits decision precision/F1 and generation precision trajectories. The numerical tables remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, update equations, objectives, correlation/product-bound reasoning, and Appendix J derivation are retained. The LPIPS equation has a typesetting difference without a mathematical change.

C1.justification: The three principal contributions and abstract/conclusion claims are retained. The introduction adds an explicit efficiency claim that removing temporal buffers reduces memory and accelerates training and inference.

C2.justification: v3 explicitly links efficiency to avoiding temporal buffers. Section 4.2 reframes the five-second example around its decline from 45.68% to 42.06%, replacing the baseline comparison. Appendix A's limitations and the appendix failure explanations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The abstract newly provides a repository location for code, model weights, and the benchmark. This adds access information, although repository contents cannot be verified from the PDFs. Appendix D's implementation details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Sections 1–2 substantially broaden positioning through long-video streaming/planning research and a new Visual Generation discussion, including Video-MME, LongVLM, HM-Diffuser, Endora, and SurgSora. They revise the characterization of GraSP and SWAG and remove the earlier SurgRAW/GP-VLS discussion.

P1.justification: Localized introduction and related-work rewrites accompany an affiliation edit, added cross-references, funding acknowledgments, and the new checklist. The method, experimental narrative, and appendix organization are largely retained.

P2.justification: Figure 3 is redrawn with fewer curves, shaded bands, revised colors, legends, ticks, and panel proportions, and is relocated. Figure 2 receives a small labeling edit; Figure 4 and surrounding text reflow. The remaining figures and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: The broader, more nuanced research positioning, documented resource link, and corrected Figure 3 reading modestly improve context, usability, and factual accuracy. The benefit is limited by undefined uncertainty bands and checklist statements contradicting the described LLM-based method and new benchmark. The underlying experimental evidence is unchanged.
